title.narrative: Earmarked contribution to Global Initiative against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) 2022-2024

description.narrative:
The Danish contribution will be used to enable The Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) work on research and project on organized crime. The contribution runs from 2022-2024.
The contribution is earmarked to activities in countries on The Horn of Africa, in West Africa and the Sahel, and ODA-eligible countries in Eastern Europe.
GI-TOC strategic objectives: 1. Awareness and analysis: increase the evidence base and understanding of organized crime and its links to security conflict and instability 2. Action: facilitate and catalyze innovative policy-relevant responses to crime and conflict 3. Resilience: strengthen local resilience and responses to organized crime and instability 4. Bolster partnerships: enhance and leverage partnerships for more effective responses to crime and conflict 5. The future: consolidate a decade of growth and position the organization for the future as a key partner in international and community responses to build resilience to organized crime.
